Tracy, saw REBA launch REBA Rent and BI TrueSight, roll out rebaAI across products, and acquire Markerr ahead of Insights in Vail.

A product and acquisition push like that usually opens more multifamily operators than the team can touch, and good-fit accounts go cold before a rep reaches them. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for REBA off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Tracy, quick follow-up for REBA.

With new products and a fresh acquisition, pipeline expectations rise faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit target, so the coverage gap surfaces late and business development drowns in research.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings REBA needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.

I pulled a benchmark of how REBA's reply rate likely compares to other proptech teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?

Tracy, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters, and launching new products plus integrating Markerr keeps business development busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your multifamily motion? I'll tailor it to REBA either way.
